message.content: This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with the red title "TEMPO" across the top. Below, a man’s face is split vertically. The left half shows the face of a man with dark hair, a slight smile, and light reflecting off his forehead and cheek. The right half of the face is depicted on a rolled-up magazine held by a hand. This second face has more prominent wrinkles and a different nose and lip shape. The hand holding the rolled magazine has visible fingernails and skin texture. The background is a solid light gray. At the bottom right, the text "PRABOWO SUBIANTO DAN JOKO WIDODO" is printed. The rolled magazine cover has the headline "BANDAR CALON DKI-1" and the date "EDISI 26 MARET-1 APRIL 2012". At the top, several news headlines are listed in white capital letters, including "KONFLIK MAKINDO JERAT PEJABAT IMIGRASI", "PARTAI BEREBUT KOMPENSASI RP 25 TRILIUN", "MENGHADANG WABAH ‘TOMCAT’", and "ANAK DI LUAR NIKAH: MUI VERSUS MK". A barcode and price "RP 29.700" are in the bottom left corner.
